title: 幸福
content:
一個人問佛陀：我想要幸福。
佛陀說：首先去掉"我"，也就是自我。
然後去掉"想要"，也就是慾望。
如果你不自私，也不貪婪，你就不會太在意個人利益。
現在，讓我們看看你還剩下什麼：
只有"幸福"！
author: 軼名

title: Happiness
content:
A man asked Buddha: I want happiness.
Buddha said: First, please remove "I", that's ego.
Then, please remove "want", that's desire.
If you aren't selfish and aren't greedy, either, you won't worry too much about your personal interests.
Then let's see now what you are left with:
"HAPPINESS!

title: 介紹
content:
「族譜平台」是一項服務平台提供多種服務，幫助您建立並管理家譜。隨著日益成員的增長，您的族譜將成為傳承給子孫後代珍貴遺產的一部分。
族譜平台目前提供三種網路服務：

1. 第一種名為：「FamilyTrees」的企業版網路服務
它允許互聯網服務企業透過互聯網，提供所有註冊家庭及會員相互連接分享。

2. 第二種名為：「FamilyTreesPE (ftpe)」的個別家庭版網路服務
這是個別家庭版，完全免費使用，也是開源的。您可以在 GitHub 下載應用程式碼，並在您的電腦上獨立運行。

3. 第三種名為：「FamilyTreesOps (subs)」的網路服務
這是一個通訊訂閱服務，提供個別家庭成員間分享及訂閱其家庭消息及活動的服務。

title: Introduction
content:
The 'FamilyTrees Platform' provides a Service Platform that consists of multiple services to help you manage your family tree. As part of your precious heritage, a complete family tree can be passed along to future generations.
There are three kinds of web services under the FamilyTrees platform

1. The first kind of on-line web services, called 'FamilyTrees' services
It allows ISP provider/organization enabling its registered members to build and connect related family trees over Internet on which members share and form a bigger related community.

2. The second kind of web services, called 'FamilyTreesPE (ftpe)' services
This FREE personal-edition web service provides individuals to manage his/her own family tree, even off-line running on his/her laptop.

3. The third kind of on-line web services, called 'FamilyTreesOps (subs)' services
This web service provides newsletter publication/subscription for your own family members to keep in touch and receive news and family events.
